nom: Saturday Skin Yuzu Vitamin C Brightening Sleep Mask

avis.texte: This slight citrus scented face mask is a gel base with encapsulated vitamin C and cold pressed yuzu seed oil that's burst its presence onto your skin when rubbed. You apply after your moisturizer at night and leave on overnight. It is a little sticky when you first put on. It's best if applied about 1 hour before bed to dry better and absorb well before lying down. You can use it 3-5 times a week . It leaves my skin feeling hydrated and bright in the morning. I've had no irritation or clogged pores. No breakouts or burning. Saturday skin is one of my favorite Korean skin care lines.

I've been using this sleep mask for years, and I really love how it feels, smells and I always see the results after using it. It makes my skin super soft, smooth and over time it really evens out my skin tone. Happy it's available at Ulta now!

avis.titre: Just not right for my skin type
avis.texte: I really liked it but theres something in it that makes my skin break out and get very oily. I gave it to my SIL and she loves it.
I'm a skincare junkie and I really love this product! It hydrates extremely well and has great ingredients.
This is for sure an every night used item!! cannot go to sleep without it.
I will keep using this product forever. Keeps face supple and hydrated.
My face was visibly plump in the morning. And after 2 weeks it really did look more radiant. I would definitely buy again.
This feels good on my skin, and yeah I've had some other night creams that left my skin tingling and almost feeling like it burns. Not so with this, thankfully!

I have been using this every other day in my night care routine for 2 weeks and have noticed that the pores around my nose have reduced in sized! I'm very impressed as I have tried everything to make my nose pore smaller I'm very insecure about it. Will be buying again!
I love this sleep mask in combination with facial moisturizer! Out works wonders in plumping skin to reduce signs of wrinkles!
Lovely and effective. Look for a coupon and autodelivery to save a few dollars. D
Only a small amount is needed when I use this. It's pretty wonderful. Skin feels wonderful.

avis.titre: Bought this on a whim and love it
avis.texte: I knew nothing about this product, but it was on sale and looked good, so I took a chance. Love it and will repurchase.
Great product! Used it for the first time and even after one use my skin felt soft and smooth the next morning.

Love! Love! Love! Deeply moisturizing but not oily. At the beginning I only used at night, but now in the morning as well. Skin feels supple and wrinkle minimizing and the glow is beautiful. I can't judge the effectiveness of the vitamin C since I only have been using it for a few weeks. But I'm a long time user of vitamin c serums.
I really like using this product! It makes my skin feel so hydrated! I live in the Midwest so I'm exposed to cold weather, this mask gives me the moisture it needs! Definitely recommend.

I have the worlds driest skin after I had my daughter 6 years ago and I haven't found anything that acts makes my skin feel so soft without making me break out really bad. I've only used for 2 nights now but typically if I use something in my skin by morning I'm broken out or it doesn't work and I have to put moisturizer on 34 times a days. And with this I don't have to. I absolutely love it
Seemed to smooth and moisten skin just as I hoped it would. !

avis.titre: Great product at a reasonable price!
avis.texte: I am really surprised about this product. I always had puffiness after night. But after this product everything just went away. And also noticed that the pigmentation become lighter.

I got this in my ipsy box and now I have to reorder it. Im in my mid30s in a time where I have the pleasure of mild acne and fine lines at the same time. This product is perfect for my combination skin! When I wake up my skin looks plumper, wellrested and so glowy. Love this stuff!
My skin looks and feels so moist and glows when i use this product!!! It says to use your moisturizer first and then use this ... I do NOT!!! This stuff is ALL you need!!!

I am a fan of the overnight facial mask but many can be pricey. I decided to give this a try, not expecting much. I truly like it! It says to only use a few days per week but i started using most nights I think my skin looks better brighter, more smooth. I have sensitive skin and i have no irritation. I liked it so much that I bought 2 more to give to family.
i am obsessed with the waterfall glacier water cream and wanted to give something new a chance. not crazy about the texture of the sleep mask but it does stay moistuized,
whenever i use this product i always have great skin the next day! only thing is i feel like there is not a lot of product really. but whenever this goes on sale i like to get it
loved the feel of the product. goes on like silk smells great too

This mask is wonderful. Overnight my dark spots are noticeably lightening much more quickly than just my kiehls dark spot serum. My skin tone overall is more even. Fine lines on my forehead are visibly smoother. My skin has been more sensitive this past year but I've had no problem using this mask several times a week. I recommend easing up to that amount of use gradually. This tub will last you a while. It only takes one scoop that comes with to cover my entire face. I did break the plastic that separates the scoop and lid from the product inside but it hasn't been too much of an issue.

This mask smells wonderful and does a great job of moisturizing. There are actual Yuzu chunks in the mask so it can't be fully rubbed in, also it feels a bit sticky all night while you're wearing it. I wouldn't recommend wearing it with silk pillowcases.
Ive been using it for two years. Always receive compliments on my skin
I have been using it about a week and I can already see my skin brightening up. It works quickly and leaves the skin feeling super hydrated.

The vitamin c works great to brighten the skin . It has a smooth and thin texture with a soothing feeling. Overnight masks are for great for waking up with a luminous glow and hydrated skin. Complimentary from saturdayskin.

Gifted by Saturdayskin.Ive been using the 8Hours of Glow Yuzu Vitamin C Sleep Mask, and its a gamechanger for overnight hydration. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky. It leaves my skin feeling plump and noticeably brighter by morning. The subtle citrus scent is refreshing but not overpowering. Perfect for dull or tired skin when you need a glow boost!

gifted by saturday skin but all opinions are my own. when i lived in korea, i tried a sleep mask with yuzu in it and loved it! this reminds me of it!!! feels so lightweight and moisturizing without making my face feel irritated or greasy. in the morning my face feels nice and hydrated.

I received this complimentary from Saturday Skin. Ive purchased this product before but it was a while ago. I remember now why I liked it so much! Not only does it smell really nice like fruity, but I loved the results! I have combination skin and I use this as a moisturizer after my serum. I havent had any issues with it absorbing properly, nor with it being sticky. I really enjoy Saturday Skin and their yuzu line is particularly fabulous because of the vitamin c which I benefit from most out of all other ingredients because I tend to have lingering spots.

I have never felt or seen my skin glow after using the sleep mask. I am only using 23 times a week and I love that you dont have to use a lot of product to cover your face. Definitely a product I will continue to use

I love this overnight mask I use it whenever my face needs a boost and thats just what it does. I put it on at night and wake up to plump hydrated skin that smooth and radiant. I also love the texture of this mask!! Gifted by Saturday skin

Ive been loving this sleeping mask gifted by saturdayskin! The texture is perfect for nighttime since its a thick gel and doesnt leave a residue. I really appreciate that it has retinol in it which really helps smooth out the texture of my skin. I wake up with glowy plump skin, like I drank 2 gallons of water and slept 9 hours.

Complimentary from saturdayskin. Im a big fan of this product so far. The consistency is like a serum not really a mask. I apply it before bed my skin hasnt reacted poorly or anything. Feels like orange juice for the skin

complimentary from saturdayskin. I was really excited to try this Yuzu Vitamin C Sleep Mask, and it did not disappoint! Before using it, my skin felt dull, dry, and a little tiredlooking. I have combination skin, so Im always looking for something that hydrates without making me oily. The texture is light, gellike, and super smoothit feels cooling when you put it on, which I loved. It absorbs well and doesnt feel heavy or sticky like some sleep masks do. The most important for me, my skin doesn't bake out in the morning. n the morning, my skin felt so soft, plump, and really glowy!

avis.titre: It's nice, but not for my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I love the cheerful yellow packaging and how versatile this product is, working as a night cream, mask, or sleeping mask. Ive only used it as a sleeping mask so far, and my skin felt incredibly smooth and soft the next morning. That being said, it was a bit strong for my sensitive skin. I woke up in the middle of the night with some itchiness around my nose, which I suspect was due to the combination of retinol and glycolic acid. My skin may need time to adjust, but for now, I see myself using it once a week or at most every two weeks because of this. Gifted by Saturday Skin

avis.titre: More a hydrating cream than a mask
avis.texte: I think this feels more like a water base mask. It still does the job but it feels more like a hydrating cream

What i like about this is its an extra step, you add it after your moisturizer. Its not thick, in fact it's a thin mask, it has yuzu, vitamin c, niacinamide, and retinol. You don't have to use it everyday. It's purpose is to brighten face and lighten darkspots, therefore making the skin look younger and more supple. With continual use you start to see the dark spots fade. Its got a light smell, typical yuzu, fresh smelling. complimentary from saturdayskin.

I have been interested in this product ever since seeing it in a subscription box. I always like an overnight mask although I tend to just use them as my moisturizer. This one specifically mentioned to still apply both a serum and moisturizer and layer this product overtop. I did find when I did that it helped lock in the moisturizer even more. The vitamin c in this product was nice as well and its not too intense. Usually if a vitamin c product is too intense it can make my skin peel but this did not. The product is a clear gel with yellow pieces that look like a citrus peel throughout. The yellow pieces do just dissolve easily as you apply it to your skin. Its a fun effect. The product has a nice yuzu scent that I love. Also it has a scoop included in the cap that is nice. All in all this is something Ill definitely use up and maybe rebuy. This product was gifted by saturdayskin for my review.

avis.titre: First Impressions of the Sleep Mask Impressed!
avis.texte: I tried the Yuzu Vitamin C Sleep Mask gifted by Saturdayskin, and it's so refreshing for my dry to normal skin. Before use, my skin felt dehydrated and tight. After using it overnight, I woke up to plump, hydrated skin. The mask has a smooth, jellylike texture that feels soothing. I will be implementing this in my weekly skin care routine!

Im already a big fan of Saturday Skin, so I was excited to try their Vitamin C Sleep Mask. Im really enjoying it! Its lightweight and sinks in quickly without leaving my face feeling tacky, or getting any residue on my pillow while I sleep. In the morning I wake up with my skin feeling bouncy and refreshed. I am kind of torn on the packaging though. On one hand, I like how it fits in with their other moisturizers, but the actual amount of product is very small in comparison to the size of the jar. That just feels like wasting plastic for no reason. I wish theyd change it, because the product itself is really nice! Gifted by Saturday Skin

Saturday Skin Yuzu Vitamin C Sleep Mask was kindly gifted to me by the brand. This mask is formulated with yuzu, niacinamide and retinol to deliver antioxidants and improve uneven tone and texture. It smells so nice with fruity yuzu scent and leaves my skin glowing in the morning.

Loving the refreshing feel and light, gellike texture. It absorbs well without feeling sticky or heavy and gives my skin a nice boost of hydration overnight. I wake up with my skin looking more refreshed and bright!! The yuzu scent is subtle and citrusy, which makes it feel extra fresh when applying. While its marketed as a vitamin C mask, it feels more like a deeply hydrating treatment rather than a potent brightening one. Its a great option if youre looking for a lightweight overnight mask that leaves your skin feeling soft and replenished by morning. Gifted by Saturday Skin

This overnight mask gifted by Saturday Skin is really unique in that it has an interesting texture with flecks in it that somehow absorb overnight while the product goes to work to moisturize and brighten the skin. I have combination skin with mild rosacea, and experienced zero issues with using this product. It felt really nice and slightly cooling on my skin upon application. It absorbed easily and left my skin feeling and looking both refreshed and balanced in the morning.

Gifted by Saturday Skin. Ive been loving this sleep mask! Its super lightweight, absorbs well, and leaves my skin feeling so refreshed in the morning. The combo of ingredients like vitamin c and glycolic acid really helps to brighten and smooth my skin overnight. This is great if youre looking for a hydrating and brightening overnight mask that wont feel heavy!
Leaves my skin look sooooo moisturized . Directions say apply after moisturizer and i do just that, let it completely dry and sink in before laying down for bed

I am a fan of the overnight facial mask but many can be pricey. I decided to give this a try, not expecting much. I truly like it! It says to only use a few days per week but i started using most nights I think my skin looks better brighter, more smooth. I have sensitive skin and i have no irritation. I liked it so much that I bought 2 more to give to family.
I got a sample in my ipsy subscription. Great product, I came to buy more when the sample ran out. I think it really brightens my skin. I also really enjoy the smell!

avis.titre: My skin feels smooth next morning.
avis.texte: I use this skin treatment once a week as they suggest that it is not for daily treatment. My skin feels smooth next morning as soon as I wash my skin. I am using this only for 2 months and its long term benefit is yet to be known.

It smells so nice but be careful if you have sensitive skin. Made my skin slightly pink and stung a little. I gave it to my mom and she loves it though. She says it makes her very moisturized and brightens her skin

A really good sleep mask!! I put it on at night after my moisturizer and wake up to brighter and more even tone skin. It has a thick texture and goes on so smoothly. It absorbs so easily into my skin and doesnt have an overbearing smell. Gifted by saturday skin

Complimentary from Saturday Skin. This moisturizer has a lightweight gel consistency. The product spreads easily on the skin and sinks in nicely without leaving a greasy finish. I can't tell if it has helped brighten my skin since I haven't used it for an extended period. However, I'm looking forward to seeing what the longterm effects are with prolonged usage.

Complimentary from saturdayskin! I want to give my honest review about this product, Im very familiar with this brand and this is my first time trying this sleep glow product! First the packaging looks so similar to the pink water moisturizer that they have, very cute packaging but in color orange, the texture is nice and soft, not too thick and absolutely not sticky, Ill include this product as part of my skincare routine, my face feels so plump and youthful.

avis.titre: Gives my a healthier looking skin
avis.texte: I apply this overnight especially on days when I have know my skin is tasty. I put it on after cleansing and I wake up the next morning with a nice glow and plumper looking skin. It hasnt broken me out which is great. Gifted by Saturday skin.

I received Yuzu Vitamin C Sleep Mask complimentary from Saturday Skin. This sleep mask locks in moisture and brightens and smooth the skin. My skin looks radiant and plump in the morning. It also smells wonderful.

Saturday Skin 8 Hours of Glow Sleep Mask hydrates, brightens, and refreshes overnight. Lightweight yet nourishing, it leaves skin soft and radiant by morning. A great pick for a glowing complexion! Complimentary from saturdayskin

My skin felt a little dull and dehydrated before using this, but after this mask, it looked noticeably fresher. The gel texture is lightweight and smooth. I have combination skin, and this gave me a nice, dewy finish without making my tzone more oily. The hydration lasts, and my skin feels soft and bouncy. complimentary from saturdayskin

Complimentary from saturdayskin this mask is very nice and my skin felt great afterwards. Its super hydrating. My makeup applied very nicely afterwards. Make sure to use sunscreen when using this face mask

avis.titre: The benefits for your skincare routine.
avis.texte: I really really enjoy this product. I recently purchased this and so far I've been pleasantly pleased. It feels really cool and decent on my skin not gooey at all and my skin in the morning looks really refreshed. I highly recommend this product

Love a good vitamin C sleeping mask!!!! Vitamin c for the face is very good because it helps brighten the skin and makes you look awake!!! I woke up this morning with a glowy face and felt so good in my skin!!! Must have mask for sleeping!!! This was gifted by Saturday Skin

I received this complimentary from saturdayskin. It has an interesting texture but it does blend in and didn't get on my pillow. The winter time is terrible for my skin and I usually feel so dry even with a humidifier. With this sleep mask, I woke up with my skin feeling hydrated and soft.

avis.titre: Smells and feels great on my skin!
avis.texte: The Saturday Skin Yuzu Vitiamin C Sleep Mask helped my combination skin look brighter and feel more balanced. The first thing I noticed was the crisp virus scent, which I loved. The texture of this mask is lightweight and gellike, with small soft bits of yuzu that melt into my skin as soon as you apply it. It feels cooling and hydrating and doesn't leave any sticky residue. After using it overnight, my skin felt refreshed, smoother, and more balanced. The dry patches looked more hydrated, and my overall complexion had a healthy glow. It didnt clog my pores or make my oily areas worse, which is a huge plus for combination skin. I would definitely purchase this sleep mask again because it smells great and feels great on my skin. Complimentary from saturdayskin

avis.titre: Smells and feels great on my skin!

The texture of this mask is lightweight and gellike, with small soft bits of yuzu that melt into my skin as soon as you apply it. It feels cooling and hydrating and doesn't leave any sticky residue. After using it overnight, my skin felt refreshed, smoother, and more balanced. The dry patches looked more hydrated, and my overall complexion had a healthy glow. It didnt clog my pores or make my oily areas worse, which is a huge plus for combination skin. I would definitely purchase this sleep mask again because it smells great and feels great on my skin. Complimentary from saturdayskin

This is the first product I try with yuzu and I love it! The gel texture makes this so refreshing and lightweight compared to typical cream moisturizers. My skin ate this up instantly and I could quickly notice better skin. This was gifted by Saturday skin

This Saturday Skin 8Hour Glow Yuzu Vitamin C Sleep Mask makes my skin feel soft and refreshed in the morning. The texture is light and easy to apply. It gives my skin a nice glow since it has been super dull, and it doesn't feel heavy. I like this balance. I wake up with my face looking bright and healthy! Complimentary from Saturdayskin

The Saturday Skin Yuzu Vitamin C Sleep Mask is a nighttime glow booster! Its lightweight yet hydrating, soaking into the skin as you sleep. Infused with yuzu and vitamin C, it brightens and smooths, leaving my skin soft, radiant, and refreshed by morning. Gifted by saturdayskin

This is amazing for instant hydration and I love how it smells so delicious and citrus so it feels super refreshing. I like how this targets my dark spots and its good for women of color so you can get better treatment for that hyper pigmentation. Im honestly loving it so far this was gifted to me.

Gifted by Saturdayskin. I love the texture of this mask, and it feels great to spread on the face. It also smells great as well. The scent seems to purely come from the fruit extracts and oils, as theres no other added fragrance in the ingredient list. This mask has so many goodies like retinol, niacinamide, ceramides, and several different kinds of peptides too. It may be possible that people that have reactions to this product are reacting to the retinol or the oils that are in this product. For me personally, it works great and my skin feels super soft after!

I love the scent of this mask so much! Anything with yuzu it is a plus! It applies to the skin easily and feels amazing. I also think it is quite hydrating and moisturizing! It also has enough product to last a while! Complimentary from saturdayskin

I am a fan of using sleeping mask. If I see a promising product on the market I buy it. This sleeping mask is a very good and high quality. It moisturizes your skin through creating the skin barrier protection overnight. As a result, you wake up with healthy glow face. Also, the sleeping mask calm and bright your skin. I fall in love with the product. However, it is too pricey for my budget. I have to look for a similar product for much affordable price. One jar is about a twoandhalf months when you apply it with a mask brush 3 times per week. If this price is good for you I say to go for it! You will not be sorry.

avis.titre: Great if you want glowing skin
avis.texte: I've been using the Saturday Skin 8 Hours of Glow Yuzu Vitamin C Sleep Mask, and I absolutely love it! The lightweight gel formula feels so refreshing and easy to apply, and the subtle citrusy scent is a lovely bonus. What really makes this product a winner for me, though, is how it leaves my skin looking in the morningso glowy and radiant! It's like a little jar of overnight magic. My skin feels hydrated, soft, and more plump after using it, which is such a confidence booster. If you're looking for something to add that extra glow to your skincare routine, Id definitely recommend giving this a try! Gifted by Saturday Skin

I received this sleep mask complimentary from saturdayskin in exchange for my review. This yuzu vitamin c mask is YUM! Its brightening, plumping, and smells delicious, plus it leaves me with a beautiful glow in the morning!

LOVE the smell and cooling affect of this product. It's a wonderful finishing touch to the night routine. Wake up with smooth, radianceing and dewy skin. Seriously want to eat it, it smells so decent.

My skin always feels dry and dull at the end of the day so I was excited to try the Saturday Skin 8 Hours of Glow Yuzu Vitamin C Sleep mask The texture is lightweight but still rich enough to feel nourishing It melts into my skin without feeling heavy or sticky By morning my skin feels so much softer and more hydrated and theres a noticeable glow It doesnt feel greasy just plump and refreshed With consistent use my skin looks brighter and feels way more balanced Its such an easy way to wake up with healthier looking skin.
Love the texture, it's lovely. I feel my skin is refresh the next morning. Love it. Will purchase more this is a win

This mask feels really nice and it smells so delicious. I have somewhat sensitive skin and tend to break out when trying new skin products but this mask is wonderful and did not give me any reaction. It absorbs quickly without leaving any stickiness. I really enjoy it!

This was gifted by Saturdayskin, I am absolutely obsessed with this mask! I have been looking for a good vitamin C mask that will help my skin glow and I found it. This makes my skin feel refreshed and soft. The texture is pretty good too. Love it!!

This vitamin c sleeping facial is AMAZING at fixing my skin extra glow during the winter! My skin is usually super sensitive to vitamin c but this one is so soothing and calming for my skin. Ive already started to notice a brightening effect and my fine lines appear slightly softer. It feels so wonderful on top of my essence that I use. Kindly gifted by Saturday Skin!
I have about 100 skin care products in my bathroom and this is in my top 5 favorite. Brightening and hydrating, my skin looks even and smooth upon waking up

This will for ever be in my skin care routine! My skin feels like a babies behind! Brightens and leaves a nice scent! I have very very sensitive skin and I'm very cautious what I use! Highly recommend to everyone who has the same struggle as I do! Will buy buy buy again!

Really really happy with this. Everything smells wonderful but light and rubs in beautifully. It cleared up much of the redness in my skin and really helped the pores and weird scaly skin I was getting from the winter air.

I had been looking for such formula with vitamin c and glycerin. I am happy to get it. I apply and leave it overnight. I am a lazy person so it's a decent and easy to use buy for me. With single application I am seeing decent effects. It's been a while I applied any mask or skin treatment or hydrating cream. As a result my skin was not the best and not ready for make up. Now I am happy it will make my skin ready to wear foundation.

avis.titre: Love how my skin feels and looks
avis.texte: I really enjoy this product I can see results my spots are clearing my skin feels smooth and silky. The radiance is a plus. I will purchase this product again.

avis.titre: Used Twice and Notice a Difference
avis.texte: I have only used the product twice but I already see and feel a difference in my skin. I combined this with the skin scrub and my skin looks better. Especially my long neglected neck. My skin looks smoother and more hydrated!
Love this product. Using it 23 x week and it is very effective.

avis.titre: Nice impact on my skin but....glues my skin to the pillow.
avis.texte: I wanted to like this more than I did. It is an overnight mask that is quite thick. I picked up a slight yuzu scent but it is very light. I felt that my skin looked terrific the mornings after I tried this.Unfortunately this stays very much like glue and my skin would stick to my pillow case. Not once but over and over again. That was the case even with a light application. I found it very uncomfortable to sleep with on. I'd be more apt to use it in the afternoon and evening and then wash it off prior to bed. I did like the impact but not the stickiness.

I am in really enjoy with this, my skin the next day is so smooth. I work on a pool so I need all the hydrating cream I can get. I got it on a deal so the price was worth every penny, I would even pay the non sale price. I have sensitive skin but had zero reaction to this. It's fantastic
Not what I would consider a mask.It is a nice product but I expected it to be thicker and expected it to dry completely.Not the kind of product I would wear all night.
This product works fantastic. You will really enjoy it for hydration
I got a sample of this a while back from IPSY and loved it then and finally decided to buy the full size. It is super hydrating and leaves your skin feeling buttery soft the next morning
I personally can't vouch for this product but the gift receipient really enjoys really enjoys it. Fast ship and well packaged.
I really enjoy this product. It leaves yuzu particles on your skin when u first put it on, but after it dries it's gone by morning. Highly recommend.

It's honestly the most delicious moisturizer I've ever put on my skin. I put on my serums first and I feel like it really locks in all those good ingredients and moisture. My skin is noticeably glowing and gorgeous when I wake up in the morning after I used this.
So far, it feels nice and soothes my skin. I have only been using for two weeks but I like it!
I absolutely really enjoy this mask, I use it every other day and my skin looks flawless, I'm 43 and feeling wonderful
Immediate difference in my skin! Removed dark spots and left my skin feeling so soft.

My daughter turned me on to this I use it three times a week you sleeping it it doesn't come off on the pillow cases and it really does make your skin smoother pores or thinner I will continue to buy purchases at Christmas when they went on Black Friday at half the price which is what honestly I would expect them to be normally but I will continue to buy it goes a long way for a little product usage just a fingertip will do your whole skin
I like this product it visibly helps my skin hydrated and the textures improves as well! Thank you

Absolutely really enjoy this mask! Received sample size from a store, after a few uses I noticed my skin visibly brighter and hydrated! I immediately purchased the full size! It's lightweight, non greasy and hydrating enough to not use any additional hydrating creams. Buy it!!
I have fairly sensitive skin, but this one really is incredible. My skin feels and looks younger and more vibrant as well as more even.
I really enjoy using this product! It makes my skin feel so hydrated! I live in the Midwest so I'm exposed to cold weather, this mask gives me the moisture it needs! Definitely recommend.
After used one night , got a big pimple on my cheek , not really sleeping mask , need to wash away before go to bed

First off the container is twice as big as the actual part that holds product. So the size misleads you into thinking you get way more product than what you actually get. The consistency is a lumpy gel like consistency. Has an orange citrus scent that is light and not overpowering. I have only used once so far. It's just ok. I was so excited n had high hopes for this product. We shall see.
This claims to be an overnight mask. But it has the lightweight consistency of a serum. Haven't noticed any difference while using.
I really enjoy the consistency, reliability and quality of the product
I've been using this for a couple months now and you really see a difference overnight. Face is brighter, smoother and pores are tighter.
THIS product is wonderful. It keeps me radianceing through the day.
